entities.name: Alonso Suárez de la Fuente del Sauce
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alonso Suárez de la Fuente del Sauce was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Jaén (1500–1520), Bishop of Lugo (1496–1500), and Bishop of Mondoñedo (1493–1496).
